text:
mira: Heads-up: new customer stuck on first call. Quickstart curl returns 402 and they assumed the API key was invalid. They accepted an SSO invite and never got a billing prompt.

ash: Can you paste the exact curl and response body? That will help triage.

mira: From support transcript:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.test/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_test_xyz' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"ping"}'
```
HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
Body: {"error":{"code":"billing_required","message":"workspace_incomplete"}}

sam: That's the onboarding gate. Our CLI/SDK currently surfaces only the numeric status which confuses users. We should render the server error.message and, if present, an onboarding_url. Filing a quick fix ticket.

devex-bot: Known bug: DEVEX-742 - SSO invite flows suppress the billing redirect. Workaround doc: https://go.redwood/onboard-ssogap :warning:

docops: Short-term support note: ask SSO-invite users to open Console -> Billing or visit https://console.redwood-inference.test/onboarding to complete setup. Adding to KB article.

ash: Proposal: API change to include {"onboarding_required":true, "onboarding_url":"..."} in the error payload when org state != active. SDKs map to WorkspaceOnboardingRequired error with a .onboarding_url property. I'll draft the SDK PR.

sam: Also add telemetry event first_call_blocked_onboarding so we can prioritize.

mira: Customer finished billing and the same curl returned 200. They were blocked ~25 minutes. I'll add a note to quickstart that SSO invites sometimes need manual billing completion.

devex-bot: Follow-ups: REDWOOD-1255 (API), REDWOOD-1256 (CLI/SDK mapping), KB-88 (support article).
